rules: Check latest main and existing content to avoid duplicate publishing.
Official-source fact checks, worked examples where useful, contextual inbound and outbound links.
Preserve historical dates; use real publication and review dates.
Build, check internal links and examples, push main with lease and verify production.
Calculators are the primary hubs; use the closest relevant calculator for each article, and keep guide pages as supporting content.
Every article must link to its calculator in the body and CTA/breadcrumb; the calculator must link directly back in the same release.
Run node scripts/check-daily-publishing.cjs --date=YYYY-MM-DD after build and repeat with --live after deployment.
Report three verified live URLs, hub assignments, commit and deployment evidence; a trigger or completed task is not proof of publication.
A separate daily check verifies the output and attempts one recovery of a stopped publisher, reporting every unresolved shortfall.
